description: This file contains the implementation of the LuceneIndexStore class, which manages Lucene indexes including creation, deletion, searching, and resource management within the OrchardCore project.

classes.name: LuceneIndexStore
classes.description: Manages Lucene indexes including creation, deletion, searching, and resource management.

classes.name: IndexWriterWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper around Lucene's IndexWriter with an additional IsClosing property.

classes.name: IndexReaderPool
classes.description: Manages pooling and lifecycle of IndexReader instances for efficient reuse.

classes.name: IndexReaderPool.IndexReaderLease
classes.description: A lease object for an IndexReader, ensuring proper release and disposal.

methods.name: LuceneIndexStore
methods.description: Constructor initializing the index store with dependencies and setting up the root path.

methods.name: ExistsAsync
methods.description: Checks asynchronously if a Lucene index exists at the specified path.

methods.name: RemoveAsync
methods.description: Removes an index and cleans up associated resources asynchronously.

methods.name: SearchAsync
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous search on the specified index using a provided searcher function.

methods.name: WriteAndClose
methods.description: Writes data to the index and then closes it.

methods.name: WriteAsync
methods.description: Writes data to the index, optionally closing it afterward.

methods.name: GetReader
methods.description: Retrieves an IndexReader lease for the specified index.

methods.name: GetFullPath
methods.description: Constructs the full filesystem path for an index.

methods.name: CreateDirectory
methods.description: Creates and opens a Lucene directory at the specified index path.

methods.name: FreeReaderWriter
methods.description: Releases all readers and writers to free resources.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes the index store, releasing resources.
